title: The Horse and the Donkey
summary: A merchant set out for the city with his horse and donkey. The donkey was loaded to the brim with heavy merchandise, while the horse walked free, adorned with jingling bells....
full_text:
A merchant set out for the city with his horse and donkey. The donkey was loaded to the brim with heavy merchandise, while the horse walked free, adorned with jingling bells.

Halfway along the dusty mountain pass, the donkey faltered and pleaded: "Brother Horse, take but a small part of my load, or I shall die upon this path!"

The proud horse snorted and refused to soil his back. An hour later, the donkey dropped dead in the dust.

The merchant immediately took all the heavy baggage, the grain sacks, and the donkey's skin, and piled them entirely onto the back of the horse. Staggering under the crushing weight, the horse groaned: "By refusing to lift a small share, I must now bear the whole burden alone!"
moral: Help your fellow laborer in his time of trial, lest his burden fall upon your own shoulders.

Believing rumors and flattery without proof
